title: Measurement 1: Concentration Curves & the Detection Latency Budget
superseded_by: phase_6b (D3, docs/Universe-Decisions.md): RTH-only was not wrong, but answered an RTH-conditional question when the universe (momentum_pct off high, which may occur premarket) needed the full extended trading day. This directory was renamed from results/phase_6/ (git mv, no content changes) - all paths below still say results/phase_6/... as a historical record of where they were generated.
summary: T0: branch cut, dev v4 manifest (56 events) verified 56/56 against momentum_events_canonical (5m09s), resolving phase_5a REPORT.md's event_date wording ambiguity. T1: eligibility waterfall from Phase 5a's materialized D1 frame (avoids a redundant multi-billion-row canonical-view scan) - 15,763/15,763 eligible, 0 ineligible (non-binding: in_scope already requires event-day trades). T2: dev-tier minute-bar builder + measurement pipeline verified against filtered_trades_dev_v4 (0.68s, 0 integrity violations, 0 sidecar bitmap mismatches). T3: single budgeted full pass over filtered_trades (4,951,605,544 rows, 22.04 min) materialized event_minute_bars_v1 - 30,309,950 bar rows, T=0 events exactly match T1 (15,763). T4: concentration curves, min-window stats, opportunity decay + opening-print sensitivity computed from the cache, no further full-table passes. T5: 5 charts + sortable index, kaleido-verified (two rendering bugs found and fixed during verification).

decisions_log.decision: T1 reads Phase 5a's sampling_frame.parquet instead of re-querying momentum_events_canonical
decisions_log.reason: the view's trades_ingested/quotes_ingested columns force a fresh DISTINCT scan of filtered_trades+filtered_quotes on every query; the frozen artifact is the identical query result and was freshness-checked by row count

decisions_log.decision: bars carry first_price (arg_min) alongside the prompt's named last_price (arg_max)
decisions_log.reason: open price (first in-session print) must be readable from minute 0 without a second full-table pass

decisions_log.decision: single GROUP BY including in_session produces both in-session bars and excluded-row-share stats from one scan
decisions_log.reason: escalation row 7 allows exactly one full pass over filtered_trades

decisions_log.decision: sensitivity variant re-derives its own open_price at the first post-cutoff print rather than masking minute 0
decisions_log.reason: answers what the curve would look like if the opening print hadn't happened, not just hides one data point

decisions_log.decision: chart 05 overlay groups capped at seeded n=30 per group (top/bottom decile + random), not full ~1,580-event deciles
decisions_log.reason: found via kaleido verification - full deciles rendered as unreadable spaghetti and hid the pooled band; the sortable index remains the only complete-population artifact

surprises: T1's eligibility filter is non-binding: 0/15,763 ineligible, because in_scope already excludes zero-event-day-trades events (flag_missing_event_day)
736/15,763 events (4.7%) have >50% of T=0 trade rows outside the regular session (heavy pre/post-market activity) - consistent in rate with the dev-tier finding (2/56, 3.6%)
realized-move-fraction has an extreme tail (population max 2,306, 99th pct 12.1) - large intraday round-trips relative to a small close-to-open net move, visible in chart 05's per-event traces
